title: 2007 HMMT February General Round 1 Problem 2
statement: Rectangle \(A B C D\) has side lengths \(A B=12\) and \(B C=5\). Let \(P\) and \(Q\) denote the midpoints of segments \(A B\) and \(D P\), respectively. Determine the area of triangle \(C D Q\).

solutions.text: 15. Note that \([C D P]=\frac{1}{2} \cdot 5 \cdot 12=30\), while the area of triangle \(C D Q\) is half of the area of triangle \(C D P\).
